settings.text: FAQs

settings.title: Is everything that you make plant-based and natural?
settings.text: Yes! We use the highest quality plant-derived ingredients (seaweeds, herbs, butters, clay, sea salts, sugars, and natural plant oils), focusing on naturally occurring compounds. We also formulate according to the strictest European Union standards, avoiding more than 1,300 potentially harmful chemicals that the EU has banned.

settings.title: What order do I apply the skincare products in?
settings.text:
Pro Tips

  • Layering Matters: Apply products from least to most occlusive (thinnest to thickest).
  • Simplify Your Ritual: Skip steps that don’t serve your skin’s needs.
  • Trust Your Skin Intuition: If it feels right for you, it is!
  • No Worries with Actives: Our bioavailable actives are designed to work harmoniously together.
  •  Go Slow & Steady: Introduce new products gradually to allow your skin to adjust.
  • Consistency is Key: Regular use delivers the best results.

settings.title: Are your products gluten and soy free?
settings.text: Yes, all of our products contain no added gluten and no added soy. However, since we are not certified gluten-free or soy-free, we can't guarantee they are completely free of trace amounts.

settings.title: Are your products Non-GMO?
settings.text: Yes, and each ingredient is verified as such!

settings.title: What is the shelf life of your products?
settings.text: Use Earth Harbor products within 12 months of purchase to ensure optimal freshness. To maintain freshness for that span of time, always wash your hands before use, keep products out of direct sunlight and in a cool, dry place.

settings.title: Do you use preservatives?
settings.text: Yes, but no sketchy synthetic preservatives are allowed! By natural, we actually mean it. If we sell a product that has a water-soluble component, we use an entirely natural preservative to stave off the development of mold, fungus & bacteria and run third party stability + challenge tests to prove it. We are serious about every ingredient we use being researched across leading, trustworthy health & safety databases to ensure our formulas qualify for the very best, safest, and non-toxic categories — that's why we use reliable plant-based preservatives in our formulas. Check out each ingredient for yourself (available on every product page), and/or please get in touch if you have questions about the incredible eco-preservatives we use.

settings.title: Are your products made for sensitive skin?
settings.text:
Yes, our products are safe and effective for sensitive skin. We conduct patch testing (RIPT, sensitive skin, and overseen by a dermatologist) on all of our formulas to ensure they work across all skin types, with a special focus on sensitive skin, this guarantees suitability for even the most delicate skin.

Our products are formulated with proven actives and undergo rigorous testing to ensure both safety and long-term efficacy. However, we always recommend performing your own patch test on a small area of skin to make sure the product works for you, as everyone's skin is unique and may react differently.

Keep in mind, some people experience skin purging when introducing new products. To minimize this, we suggest alternating between products for 3 to 5 days instead of using several new products all at once. Overloading your skin can be overwhelming, so it's important to give it time to adjust.

settings.title: Why does my product look/smell differently than the ne purchased previously?
settings.text:
Due to the nature of using 100% pure, natural, and wild-harvested ingredients, the color, aroma, and/or texture may vary with every batch. This does not affect efficacy; it is simply the beautiful inconsistency that comes with keeping ingredients as close to the earth as we can get!

Rest assured, all batches undergo stability and challenge testing to ensure the highest standards of safety and performance, so you don’t have to worry about the quality of the product.

settings.title: Why does my Nymph Nectar have little beads/whitish specks in it?
settings.text:
Because we leave out unnecessary fillers and stabilizers, this can result in the development of a bead-like texture/whitish specks in your balm. This is completely normal, doesn’t change the efficacy, and they will melt on contact with your skin (or by warming the balm in your hands before applying). The texture will dissolve from your body heat. 

If you prefer to dissolve them, we suggest melting the balm in a ‘water bath’. You simply place the product (keeping it in its jar) in a pot on the stove with a low temperature setting and water below its tightened lid. Let the balm melt completely and then let it cool all the way through in your refrigerator. Then, keep Nymph Nectar stored below 75 °F.

settings.title: Why isn’t Earth Harbor EWG certified or USDA organic certified?
settings.text: Certification for EWG and USDA organic is extremely resource-dense for brands. As a bootstrapped small independently-owned brand, we put our efforts into providing our own detailed information about the ingredients we use, carefully source each ingredient in-house (an industry rarity), and take it a step further with our founder being a toxicologist that audits each product. We proudly pour the monetary resources that certifications would take into using the highest quality, ethically sourced ingredients instead. FYI: All ingredients are non-GMO derived, would qualify for the best EWG rankings, and many are certified organic!

settings.title: Are your products non-comedogenic?
settings.text:
We formulate all of our products with the most sensitive and reactive skin types in mind. Our products are dermatologically tested, third-party tested for sensitive skin, and clinically tested to ensure both safety and effectiveness.

And we are here to bust the myth about products being "non-comedogenic". You won't find us using this word because no governing body nor test can determine whether an ingredient or product is non-comedogenic, so rather than making a marketing claim that no one can actually back up, we choose to inform our customers about this and encourage a skin patch test before use since every person's skin is different-- the skin patch test you perform is actually the only way to tell if a product (or ingredient) is noncomedogenic for your unique skin!

settings.title: How do you define "natural" and "synthetic-free"?
settings.text:
At Earth Harbor, we define natural as plant-based, mineral-based, or bio-identical—meaning our ingredients mimic nature to deliver safe and effective results. Every ingredient we use meets internationally recognized natural skincare standards.

Our formulas prioritize naturally occurring compounds and are made exclusively from renewable resources. They only undergo changes through biological processes such as fermentation, distillation, and cold processing. We never use synthetic dyes, synthetic fragrances, or synthetic preservatives.

Each of our products is 100% nature-identical, purely natural, and minimally processed, ensuring they are both effective and safe for your skin. Thanks to our advanced use of botanically based preservatives, they remain protected from mold and bacteria—without the need for synthetic additives.

settings.title: Are your products vegan & cruelty-free?
settings.text: Yes. Every ingredient is vegan and there is no animal testing whatsoever. We are animal lovers through and through, and it is very important for us to remain cruelty-free. P.S. We're PETA® and Leaping Bunny® certified. ;)

settings.title: Where do you source your materials from?
settings.text: We are committed to supporting companies that operate with sustainable, fair-trade practices and that also provide the freshest possible ingredients. Those we source from range from small independent farmers to larger cooperatives that obtain most of their ingredients from organic and/or wildcrafted sources. The ingredients are then rushed to us so we can bring you the freshest, most effective products possible. Our ingredients are predominantly sourced from within the United States and are responsibly sourced no matter what. We always ensure our strict ethics align with those we source from.

settings.title: Are your products made in the U.S.?
settings.text: Yes, our family owned and operated business started on beautiful Saint Simons Island, Georgia, and our studio is now nestled in the pristine mountains of Utah, where everything is crafted in-house. This includes everything from making, infusing, bottling, labeling, and shipping! Look at our boxes, and you’ll see they are made by us under our company name, Ethical Earth Brands, LLC.

settings.title: Are your products made in small batches?
settings.text: Yes! Each product is made in an intimate, small batch by skilled artisans. This keeps ingredients fresh and pure, thus ensuring your products are incredibly nutrient dense and effective.

settings.title: Will your products work on my skin?
settings.text:
We ensure our products work for all skin types by conducting third party patch testing (RIPT, sensitive skin, and overseen by a dermatologist). Our formulas are crafted with proven actives and undergo rigorous testing to ensure both safety and efficacy. We also perform third-party testing specifically for sensitive skin, with the most delicate skin types in mind. To guarantee your satisfaction, we offer a 30-day Love-It Guarantee.

Since everyone's skin is unique, we recommend giving the products 28 days to allow your skin to adjust and purge. This is especially important when transitioning to 100% clean & natural skincare for the first time. It's crucial to ease into new products—particularly ones like ours, which are rich in bio-actives and free from fillers. And remember, a little goes a long way!

We’re here to assist you with product recommendations and would love to guide you through a custom skincare ritual tailored to your unique skin type. Take our Skincare Quiz for immediate suggestions on the essentials, or reach out to us at hello@earthharbor.com to connect with our Skincare Expert!

settings.title: What qualifies as an active ingredient in your products?
settings.text: All ingredients in our formulas serve a therapeutic purpose, but we only count an ingredient as a true active if it serves a stronger therapeutic role—meaning it has a direct, visible impact on the skin, such as promoting cell turnover, improving hydration, or delivering specific skin benefits. Ingredients that provide more functional therapeutic roles, like texture, viscosity, or stability, support the overall effectiveness of the product but are not typically classified as actives in our active ingredient count unless they also serve a stronger therapeutic role in addition to their functional role. This distinction helps us highlight the ingredients that provide the most noticeable and measurable benefits for your skin, even though, technically, all ingredients could be considered actives in our products!

settings.title: Are your products safe to use during pregnancy and/or while breastfeeding?
settings.text: Yes, however, every person and pregnancy is different, so if you have any questions or concerns about ingredients and pregnancy/breastfeeding, please consult with your physician. The complete list of ingredients can be found under each product listing on our website.

settings.title: Do you have refills and/or a plastic free option?
settings.text:
Yes! Here is a link to our refill and plastic-free options that are 100% zero-waste: https://earthharbor.com/collections/refills-plastic-free

Our refills are our Earth Harbor gems, sealed with aluminum tops and free of any plastics! Many other brands incorporate pouches as part of their refill programs. However, we’ve been crunching sustainability-focused numbers and our approach with glass bottles and aluminum tops has an even lower ecological footprint! Aluminum, like glass, is widely and easily recycled.

Go completely plastic-free with our first-of-its-kind reusable + recyclable dispenser that can be used with any of our line-wide liquid refills to create a 100% plastic-free experience. With this option that replaces regular product tops, zero-waste just became more accessible. Shop our Plastic Free Dispenser.

settings.title: How do I properly store my Earth Harbor products?
settings.text: Tightly close all lids and caps after opening. Store your products upright in a cool, dry place away from sunlight. All products are safe to be stored in the refrigerator (although not necessary), and it might change the consistency of that product.

How soon can I expect my order?
settings.text:
Once an item is ordered and paid for, please allow 1-4 business days for your order to ship, unless otherwise noted in the product description. Remember, we are handcrafting items so they are at the peak of freshness when you get them! This can include making, infusing, bottling, labeling, and shipping. Handmade products take a little longer to make than mass-produced ones. Let us know if you need an item by a specific date and we will always make it a priority to try to accommodate your needs.

For U.S. Orders: We primarily ship through USPS. After leaving our studio USPS typically delivers in 2–5 business days. You will receive an email notification from us that contains tracking information once your order has been shipped.

For International Orders: Please allow up to four weeks for your order to arrive after shipping. Usually it will arrive sooner, but customs departments do have the right to hold items. This timeframe is unfortunately totally out of our hands. We are unable to pay for anything to be released from customs to you. Note that even if you receive an item(s) at a discounted price, we are required to disclose the standard full price of an item on customs forms.

settings.title: Shipping + Orders
What is your return policy?
settings.text:
We want you to love your new skincare routine! If you're not 100% satisfied with your Earth Harbor purchase, you can return it for a full refund within 30 days of purchase. We’ll even cover the return shipping! Products must be in new or gently used condition. Please note, we reserve the right to refuse a refund if a product is returned damaged or heavily used.

To process your return, email us at hello@earthharbor.com with the following details:

  • Your name
  • Order number
  • Item(s) you’re returning
  • Reason for return

We’ll respond within 3 business days with a return shipping label.

Shipping for Returns:

  • For U.S. orders: We cover the return shipping costs, but original shipping charges (if applicable) are non-refundable.
  • For international orders: If your package is unclaimed and returned to us, we may refund the cost of the products, but the shipping cost will not be refunded.

Reimbursement:
Your refund will be processed within 5 business days of receiving your return. You’ll receive an email notification once processed, and the refund will appear on your original payment method within 7–10 business days, depending on your payment provider.

Order Issues:
If you receive damaged, defective, or incorrect products, please contact us at hello@earthharbor.com. Include a photograph of any damage or defects, and we’ll make it right by replacing the affected item or correcting the order.

Exchanges:
If you ordered the wrong product and wish to exchange it, please email hello@earthharbor.com. Exchanges are only available for unopened and unused products, and you’ll be responsible for return shipping costs.

Additional Policies:

  • Returns are only accepted for U.S. orders.
  • Returns and exchanges are not accepted for promotional items (e.g., free samples, gifts with purchase, etc.).
  • Partial returns for sets, kits, or bundles are not accepted.
  • Purchases from stockists must be refunded or exchanged directly through the stockist.
  • We monitor returns for abuse and reserve the right to limit returns or exchanges.
  • Earth Harbor is not responsible for returned packages lost in transit without proof of delivery.

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us at hello@earthharbor.com.

settings.title: How do I earn Mermaid Points?
settings.text:
There are a shipload of ways to earn Mermaid Points! Start by signing up for Mermaid Rewards to earn 100 points. Then, earn points by purchasing products (1 point per $1 spent), following Earth Harbor on Instagram (15 points), referring friends (100 points), leaving a review via email (50 points), and adding your birthday for a reward present (100 points). 

These actions help you accumulate points that can be redeemed for rewards. For more details, visit the Mermaid Rewards page.

Note: To earn points, you must complete actions within the "Earn Points" section of the Rewards portal (not the informational "Earn Points" list on the Rewards page). To access the portal, go to the Rewards page, sign in under "Already a member? Sign in", and then navigate to the "Earn Points" section inside the Rewards portal.

settings.title: How do I login in my Mermaid Rewards account?
settings.text: Go to our Rewards page (found under "Rewards" in the main navigation bar). This will take you to the Rewards portal, where you'll see "Already a member? Sign in" below the "Join Now" button. Click it to log in. If you don’t have an account yet, click "Join Now" to create one.

settings.title: How do I apply my Mermaid Points to my purchase?
settings.text:
To apply your Mermaid Points, use the rewards code at checkout. 

If you haven’t received the code via email, log in to your Rewards account by going to our Rewards page and selecting "Already a member? Sign in."

Then, go to the "Rewards" section under the portal and select the voucher you're eligible for. Your code will appear on the screen and be sent to your email. Enter this code at checkout as a discount code.

Note: This code cannot be combined with other promotional codes.

settings.title: I can’t log in into my account
settings.text:
If you’re unable to sign in because you forgot your password, please reset it by selecting "Forgot your password?" on the Rewards sign-in page. An automated email will be sent to the email address on file with a link to reset your password. Once reset, you can sign in as usual. If you’re still having trouble, please contact us at hello@earthharbor.com.

If you're having trouble finding where to sign in, go to our Rewards page (found under "Rewards" in the main navigation bar). Once on the Rewards page, click on "Already a member? Sign in" right below the "Join now" button.

settings.title: How do I join Mermaid Rewards?
settings.text: Simply go to our Rewards page (found under "Rewards" in the main navigation bar). Once there, click "Join Now" and enter your email address, create a password, and check your inbox for a confirmation email from us. After confirming your account, you can log in and start earning rewards!

settings.title: How can I check my Mermaid Points balance?
settings.text:
Sign In: To view your current Mermaid Points balance, go to our Rewards page (found under "Rewards" in the main navigation bar). Then, click on "Already a member? Sign in" and log in to your account. 

Next:Your points balance will appear in the Rewards portal above the "Earn Points" section (not the informational "Earn Points" list on the Rewards page) or it can be viewed at the bottom of the portal page under the "History” section.

settings.title: Do Mermaid Points expire?
settings.text: Mermaid Points are valid for 12 months from the date of the last qualifying purchase. Each qualifying purchase will automatically extend the expiration date of all unused points in a Mermaid Rewards account for 12 months from the month of the qualifying purchase. If the Mermaid Rewards account has no qualifying purchase activity within a 12-month period, all points in the account will expire.

settings.title: I performed an action that I’m supposed to get points for but my points aren't showing up.
settings.text:
Firstly, make sure you have an account! Sign up on our Rewards page if you haven’t already.

If you already have an account, please note that it may take up to 24 hours for your point balance to update. If you're still experiencing issues after that time, contact us at hello@earthharbor.com.

Note: To earn points, complete actions in the "Earn Points" section inside the Rewards Portal(not the informational "Earn Points" list on the Rewards page). To access it, click "Rewards" in the navigation bar and sign in under "Already a member? Sign in."
